title: Serious Sam - The First Encounter
_note: The engine resolves its .gro files against the CURRENT DIRECTORY, which the template's cd /d and start /D both give it. MARKER is a per-disc .gro and deliberately NOT Install\Bin\SeriousSam.exe, which is the file the CD check itself opens: it is on BOTH Encounters' discs, so it would let the wrong one report success. Same class as BF1942's Setup.ini marker. The launcher writes the RESOLUTION only and never sam_iDriver: the engine auto-detects its renderer and persists it (sam_iDriver=1 is the 3dfx MiniGL, 3DFXVGL.DLL, not Direct3D). gfx_iRefreshRate is FR_SE1HZ, not FR_HZ: on Windows 7 any rate there makes the engine's mode switch fail at every resolution ("Cannot set display mode! ... OpenGL acceleration", .195 2026-09-29), so FLEETRES answers 0 on NT 6+ and the persisted desktop rate on XP - the same gr_se1_hz() GAMERES uses. ogl_bExclusive (2026-10-03): where the 3dfx card drives the screen the launcher writes ogl_bExclusive=1 - with 0 the canvas is a WS_CHILD, Glide's DirectDraw exclusive mode refuses it (DDERR_INVALIDPARAMS) and the game exits ~20 s in; TFE's own auto-adjust sets 0 on our ICD.
